speaker: narrator
text: Part six. The city starves. Rosa's is *for sale*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay knocks on the back door. Rosa *opens*.

speaker: chef
text: Jay. You're... *gray*.

speaker: heroGray
text: Rosa, I'm sorry. I made everyone stop *coming*.

speaker: chef
text: Why, Jay? Why did you *really* drink it?

speaker: narrator
text: Jay is quiet for a long *time*.

speaker: heroGray
text: Every day, you gave me lunch *for free*.

speaker: heroGray
text: And I could never *pay you back*.

speaker: heroGray
text: I wanted to need nobody. Not even *food*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rosa says nothing. She turns on *the stove*.

speaker: chef
text: You know what soup is for, Jay? *Sharing*.

speaker: narrator
text: A hot bowl lands on the table. Jay *eats*.

speaker: narrator
text: For the first time in weeks, he feels *hungry*.

speaker: narrator
text: His skin goes from gray, to green, to *pink*.

speaker: hero
text: Rosa. It *works*. The cure is *your soup*.

speaker: narrator
text: At the lab, Kai plugs Bit into *a lamp*.

speaker: bit
text: I'm back. Did I miss *lunch*?

speaker: hero
text: Bit. How many people drank the *smoothie*?

speaker: bit
text: One million, two hundred *thousand*.

speaker: chef
text: I have one pot. One *pot*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part seven drops in two days.
